summary: Creator Skyasterix conducts a 300 Heliolite dice summon session on the Born of Chaos banner targeting Child of Chaos in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Throughout the session, he experiences poor banner RNG, pulling off-banner legendaries like Viliana, Torrin, Labaoer, Sagomir, and Ripekas. He expresses strong frustration regarding the inclusion of standard, low-utility legendaries inside exclusive event summon pools. He warns players about the high cost of guaranteeing event heroes and their exclusive artifacts.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Versatile support hero who can switch elements, heal team members, and amplify ally damage, though acquiring duplicate copies for his artifact is extremely costly.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Standard pool legendary that creator finds frustrating to pull on an exclusive event banner.

heroes.name: Labaoer
heroes.note: dianggap low-utility legendary that dilutes the high-tier hero pool in exclusive banners.

heroes.name: Sagomir
heroes.note: Frustrating off-banner pull from exclusive dice summons for long-time players.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.note: Considered low value by veteran players when pulled from expensive event banners.

tips: Prepare up to 300 dice if attempting to guarantee an exclusive hero and their artifact on event banners.
Evaluate the full pool of potential legendaries on event banners before committing dice, as off-banner RNG can be unforgiving.
title: CHILD OF SCAM?! 😱 My WORST Summons EVER! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
